briefTitle: A Study to Find a Suitable Dose of ASP5834 in Adults With Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant consents to provide tumor specimen in a tissue block or unstained serial slides or a baseline tumor biopsy obtained after the last interventional treatment, but not more than 90 days prior to the start of study intervention.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo biopsy procedure is a subjective or judgment-based requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant has at least 1 measurable lesion per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant must have received prior standard therapy in the advanced setting, and the investigator does not see any further clinical benefit from continuing such therapy or the participant is ineligible to receive standard approved therapies.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator opinion and flexible standard therapy requirements cannot be expressed as a simple typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No more than 2 prior lines of systemic therapy are allowed in the advanced setting
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior line restrictions vary across different cohorts and parts of the study.
